## Spec reference
- Canonical spec: `.kiro/specs/NNN-feature/`
- Phase: Requirements / Design / Tasks / Implementation

## Changes
Describe what changed and why.

## Traceability and approvals
- [ ] Requirements APPROVED (with human/date)
- [ ] Design APPROVED (with human/date), or this PR is a prior spec-only phase
- [ ] Tasks APPROVED (with human/date), or this PR is a prior spec-only phase
- [ ] Code conforms to the approved spec (if implementation PR)

## Quality and security
- [ ] Typecheck / lint / tests: actual commands and outputs attached (or N/A for documentation-only)
- [ ] Threats / permission boundary changes reviewed
- [ ] No credentials, PII or unapproved production changes
- [ ] Independent reviewer feedback attached
